The following is a faithful transcription of the typed notes, original by the servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, C.F.M. Cap.
A VOCATION !.!?
As our holy Mother the Church would seem to us esteem it, might be defined as: "A call from Heaven on the part of Almighty God Himself - the eternal Architect of the universe - gently inclining and inviting the indivitual soul to choose that state of life which, in His infinite wisdom and divine solicitude, He foresees to be best adapted to its personal sanctification, and, consequently most conducive at once to the salvation of souls (hmanity) and the eternal glory of Heaven Itself.
As our holy Mother the Church would seem to have us regard it, is a call from HEAVEN on the part of GOD HIMSELF, inviting the indi- vidual soul to choose that state of life or profession which, in His divine wisdom He foresees will be most conducive to the sanctity and therfore, peace and happiness of the soul itself
As our holy Mother the Church would seem to have us regard it, is a call from HEAVEN on the part of GOD HIMSELF inclining and inviting the individual soul to choose that state of life or profession which, in His infinite wisdom, He foresees will be most conducive to its own sanctity and, consequently, best adapted to the promotion of dis divine glory and the SALVATION OF HUMANITY.
While such a call is undoubtedly offered to every boy and girl and may, therefore, / applied to the special graces whereby the Divine Lover of souls prepares and inclines each one for his particular station in society - including holy matrimony - the term "vocation" is usually understood to refer rather to the more outstanding stations: like
While such a call is undoubtedly offered every boy and girl - every indivigual able to think - and may, therefore be applied to the speciap trades whereby the Divine Lover of souls inclines and pre- pares each one for his station in society - holy matrimony included - the term, nevertheless in usually is usually used in reference to the more cutstandin and in a way more difficult stations, for example, the Holy Priest- to be a priest, a religious, an
While the term, "Vocation" may really be applied to the special graces whereby the Devine Lover of Souls prepares and inclines each individual for his state of life in the community - including holy matrimony - nevertheless
While such a call - more or less clearly is sure to come to ever boy and girl who figures at all on what they ought to do for God and their neighbor; because in His infinite goodness Almighty God
